notes.title: Mini-Reworks Patch 0.1.1.0
notes.notes:
🎃 Patch 0.1.1.0 – A Wickedly Good Update! 🃏💀
Hey everyone! We've got a terrifyingly awesome update for you! 😈 This patch brings tons of new content, reworks, and balance changes to make your nightmares even more fun. Let’s dive in! 🕵️‍♂️

🆕 New Content!

📜 30 new items – More tools to survive… or perish. 😱
🃏 7 new cards – Play your hand wisely!
🏆 25 new achievements – With unlockable goodies! Can you get them all? 🏅
🔄 Major Changes & Reworks!

⚔️ Faction mini-reworks – Almost every faction got some love (or horror)! Expect fresh new strategies!
⚡ Energy card redesign – A shocking improvement! ⚡🔄
⚖️ Balance & Fixes!

🩸 Lots of balance changes – Some cards were a bit too scary… others needed a boost!
🛠️ Lots of bug fixes – The real monsters are the bugs we squashed! 🪲🔨

That’s it for now! Let us know what you think, and as always—stay scared. 😈🖤

notes.title: Map Tutorial & Performance Patch 0.1.0.3
notes.notes:

Hey, brave adventurers! 🧟‍♂️👻

We’ve got a spooktacular patch for you, full of improvements, tweaks, and bug fixes to make your experience in the dark depths even better! ⚔️💀

We’ve revamped the old tutorial 📝 to make it easier to dive into the action 🥳, plus we’ve added a shiny new tutorial to help you navigate the map 🗺️! Now you won’t lose your way in the madness! 😵‍💫

Your journey just got faster 💨! We’ve made some behind-the-scenes improvements ⚙️ so you can enjoy smoother gameplay 🎮 and shorter loading times ⏳.

Tons of adjustments here! From monsters 🐉 and abilities 🔮 to how you find items and powerful cards 💪, we’ve fine-tuned everything for a more balanced experience 🃏! Your strategy matters more than ever. 🧠

Thanks for playing and stay tuned for more exciting updates! 🚀

Happy deckbuilding and monster slaying! 🩸

notes.title: Hero Abilities Patch 0.1.0.0
notes.notes:
🎉 Patch 0.1.0.0 Update 🎉
🚀  Game Update: Heroes & UI Overhaul! 🚀 

We’re thrilled to unveil our latest update, packed with awesome new features and improvements! 😈🃏

🌟 24 Unique Heroes: Our roster just got a major boost! We now have 24 heroes, each with their own unique starting deck, stats, and a special ability. 🦸‍♂️🦸‍♀️ Dive into new strategies and discover the perfect hero for your playstyle!

🛠️ Enhanced Deck Editor: We’ve reworked the deck editor to make customizing your deck smoother and more intuitive. 🎴✨ Now, fine-tuning your strategy is more comfortable and efficient than ever before!

⚔️ Revamped Duel Interface: We’ve given the in-game interface during duels a complete makeover! Get ready for a cleaner, more dynamic experience as you face off against your foes. 🧛‍♂️🔥

Jump back into the fray and explore these exciting changes! Happy gaming! 🎮💀

notes.title: Map, AI and localization Update! Patch 0.0.9.0
notes.notes:
Patch 0.0.9.0 Update Notes 🎉

Welcome to Patch 0.0.9.0 of our thrilling roguelike, deckbuilding horror game! This update brings significant improvements to enhance your gameplay experience:

🗺️ Map System Upgrade: We've reworked the map to provide you with more choices and the ability to plan your path in advance. Navigate strategically and make decisions that will impact your journey through the game.

🤖 AI Upgrade: Prepare for tougher challenges as we've updated the AI, making enemies harder and more intelligent. Brace yourself for intense battles and cunning adversaries.

🌐 Localization: We're excited to announce that our game is now localized in Spanish, German, and French! Enjoy the immersive experience in your preferred language.

Dive back into the horror and see if you can survive the new challenges that await! 🎮👹

Let me know if you need any further adjustments!

notes.title: More Options and more Cards - Update 0.0.8.2
notes.notes:
Patch 0.0.8.2 Update Notes 🎉
Greetings, players! We're excited to bring you the latest patch 0.0.8.2, packed with new features, enhancements, and crucial bug fixes to improve your gaming experience. Here's what's new:

New Features:
Difficulty Selection: Before each fight, you can now choose your challenge level. Select from Easy 😌, Hard 😤, or Extreme 😈 difficulty modes to tailor your gameplay experience.
Content Updates:
Flesh Monster Cards: We've expanded the card pool for our Flesh Monster faction. Dive into new strategies and tactics with these additional cards 🃏.
Faction Rebalance: The entire Flesh Monster faction has been rebalanced. Expect a more dynamic and fair gameplay experience with the updated stats and abilities ⚖️.
Bug Fixes:
Numerous bug fixes have been implemented to enhance overall game stability and performance 🛠️. Thank you for your feedback and reports that helped us identify and address these issues.
We hope you enjoy the new features and improvements. As always, your feedback is invaluable to us. Happy gaming!

The 2Weak Team 💪

notes.title: Card Design Overhaul - Update 0.0.8.1
notes.notes:
✨🃏Update 0.0.8.1 - Card Design Overhaul 🃏✨

In this update, we've completely reworked the design of our cards, bringing a fresh look to the game. Previously, cards only had text, but now we've introduced symbols for added visual appeal and clarity. Each faction now has its own unique card design, enhancing the immersion in the game world.

Additionally, we've implemented balancing updates for Baphomets and Terror cards to ensure a more fair and engaging gameplay experience.

This update also introduces a host of new cards, expanding the variety and strategies available to players. 🛡️🔮 And as always, we've squashed numerous bugs 🐞 to keep the game running smoothly.
